name: Snowfall and Sparkle at Lakeside Village
when_note: Thursday, Friday and Saturday evenings, 6 PM to 9 PM, through December 19
paras: Lakeside Village hosts Snowfall and Sparkle on The Lawn on Thursday, Friday and Saturday evenings from November 21 through December 19, 2026, from 6 PM to 9 PM. Admission is free, and so is parking.
Artificial snow flurries fall for about 15 minutes at the top of each hour, starting at 6 PM, so the displays run at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM. The center says the schedule may be adjusted for weather.
A Christmas tree with thousands of twinkling lights dances in sync with holiday songs. The center also points families to its restaurants and shops for dinner before or after the show.
The same lawn hosts the 'Tis the Season holiday concert on December 19, which adds Santa storytime and photos.
tip: Snow falls at the top of every hour, so arrive a few minutes before 6, 7 or 8 PM to find a spot on the lawn.
